metadata.evidence: We obtain the ICHI data from rakshajalan/ECIR-2018 [Github codebase](https://github.com/rakshajalan/ECIR-2018/tree/master/ECIR-18_medical_question_classification/Dataset), and maintain the same train-test data split.
